frame.headline: Selling baby rattles?
frame.line: Rattles have their own rule: 16 CFR 1510. New reel on our profile.

sources.claim: Rattles: fixture test before and after use and abuse tests
sources.quote: No portion of a rattle, when tested in accordance with the procedure of § 1510.4 below, shall be capable of entering and penetrating to the full depth of a cavity in a test fixture with dimensions shown in figure 1. ... Rattles shall meet this requirement both before and after performing the use and abuse tests of § 1500.51 of this chapter (excluding the bite and flexure tests of paragraphs (c) and (d)).
Finished product certificates must identify separately all applicable rules, bans, standards, or regulations.
